contentText: Although the operation to capture Nicolás Maduro stunned the world, it had in fact been months in the planning, involving thousands of U.S. troops and the elite Army Delta Force; President Trump said some American forces were injured and that a helicopter came under fire, while Venezuela’s acting president Delcy Rodríguez declined to give a death toll but said civilians and members of the military were killed during the assault—Gabrielle Nadler has more on the audacious operation.
